_note: preview daemon has no macOS TCC permission for ~/Documents — so this serves the /private/tmp/tactics-preview mirror, not the repo. The mirror is refreshed automatically by `python3 scripts/export.py` (it copies site/ wholesale), so no manual copy step is needed. Pages live in site/*.html; data in site/data/*.json. ⭐ 2026-09-01: the `heatmap` inline handler NOW sends Cache-Control: no-store for HTML/JS too — it previously did not, and a squad.html edit (등번호 배지) was invisible to the browser because of it. site/assets/data.js also fetches JSON with cache:'no-store' + a Date.now() cache-buster (gate G9).

configurations.name: heatmap
runtimeArgs:
import os, functools
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
class H0(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        self.send_header('Cache-Control','no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0')
        self.send_header('Pragma','no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires','0')
        super().end_headers()
port = int(os.environ.get('PORT','8123'))
H = functools.partial(H0, directory='/private/tmp/tactics-preview')
ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', port), H).serve_forever()
